title: A gate that asks which words a regex reads as a paying cue is made blocking with strict money, since its option text lists the word paid
goal: bl_authority.strict_signals reads no money signal in a gate whose text quotes paid, spend or a dollar word as a word list for a pattern (a word-list choice of a regex), so a worker's design gate is not made blocking and the item lands unattended

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;g={'question':'Which words does PRICE_ASK read as a paying cue and as a requirement cue?','options':['paying: pay, paid, spend, charge, bill; requirement: required, minimum','a wider or narrower word list'],'recommendation':'paying: pay, paid, spend'};s=a.strict_signals(g);print(s);sys.exit(1 if any(k=='money' for k,_ in s) else 0)
